parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activity rows with non-null pChEMBL values against human single-protein target CHEMBL5145. Filter to target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax_id 9606, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary, and join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
